notes.title: New Terrain Update!
notes.notes:
Hello spaceship pilots!

We are excited to announce an exciting new major update to Galactic Lander!

Welcome to a new world of limitless possibilities, where you will have the challenging task of piloting your spaceship in brand new tunnels across the galaxy that are more smooth and less chunky.
We look forward to hearing your discoveries in these new levels!

Explore the newly shaped tunnels we have marked for you, or create your own in the level editor and publish them to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/913600/workshop/]Steam Workshop[/url]!

Pilot your spaceship alone, or with a friend in both local and over-the-net co-op!

We hope you will enjoy this update as much as we had making it!

Good luck, and as always, have fun!

notes.title: 'Small Improvements' Update
notes.notes:
Greetings!

It's been a very long time since we got an update for Galactic Lander, but it's finally here!
This update brings one quality-of-life improvement and some other changes, let's take a look.

[h2]Smoother Co-op Loading[/h2]
Loading into a level with your buddy in co-op should feel a little more pleasant.
While waiting for all players to properly load into the level and get in sync, you can look at this minimalist screen and read a quick tip!

[h2]Missile Upgrades[/h2]
The new missile may look the same as the old one, but don't let that deceive you!

This update fixes an annoying bug where the missile touches/pushes the player, but does not explode.

And now, [b]missiles no longer fly through the level![/b]

[h2]Minor Networking Improvements[/h2]
Increased the network rate for sampling entites' states.

[h2]Some Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with replay ghost entities appearing when they should be.
[*] Fixed a bug where a ship's landing gears were not properly breaking when a ship gets blown up.
[*] Fixed engine particles still playing after getting detached from the ship.
[*] Fixed UI ship health status not being updated correctly when the local player's ship explodes.
[/list]

That's it!


Also, I am very happy to read all new reviews for Galactic Lander as we are reaching [b]100 reviews![/b] Exciting stuff indeed.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: 'Lander Remade' Mega-Update!
notes.notes:
Hello, and welcome to the Lander Remade update!

[h1]What is it?[/h1]
For the past month or so I have been working hard to fix many bugs in Galactic Lander, as well as add long-awaited features and mechanics.

[h1]What's included?[/h1]
The most important newly-added features are all the new additions/changes to the level editor, the new game-wide event, and improvements and changes to both the death and victory prompts, and more.

To celebrate this mega-update, a game-wide special event has also been added which will run from the 5th of May to the 15th. The new event adds 10 exclusive new levels, and upon finishing the event, you get a custom new ship skin to keep forever!

[h1]Full patch-note list[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added game-wide event 'Lander Remade'
[*] Ships now explode either when struck with a missile, or when hitting something too hard
[*] Improvements to the victory prompt menu ('try to beat' times and other stuff)
[*] Improvements to the death/loose prompt menu
[*] Fixed bugs in level editor
[*] New file browser for selecting a custom level preview for when uploading levels to the Steam workshop
[*] Fixed controls-bug in local coop split-screen gameplay
[*] Player-crate rope mechanic (which is optional, and can be turned on or off through the developer console, more info about it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/913600/announcements/detail/1628524688253963171]here[/url])
[*] New tutorial for the level editor
[*] New achievement which has to do with the new level editor tutorial
[*] Removed loading text that appears at start of level in the center of screen when playtesting a level.
[/list]

notes.title: 'Lander Remade' Update Event
notes.notes:
Hello!

All the new features for Galactic Lander are almost ready to go, and so I have set the date for the release of the new massive update (which can already be playtested on the 'testing' branch) to the 5th of May.

[h1]Game-wide event[/h1]
To celebrate this relatively-massive update for Galactic Lander, which will introduce plenty of long-requested features and bug-fixes, a new limited-time game-wide event will be launched from the 5th of May to the 15th. 

This exciting game event introduces 10 new singeplayer and coop levels which, once completed, will grant you a new exclusive player ship skin which you could keep forever.

[h1]What's included in the update?[/h1]
I don't want to include a comprehensive quite yet, as I still have some more testing and preparation to do. On the 5th of May I will post a secondary announcement with the full list of features and bug-fixes.


I hope you are excited, because I am!
Thanks for reading, and as always, have fun!

notes.title: Coop Vote Optimization, Bug Fix, And More!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Today's patch helped optimize the co-op playing expierence, as well as fix a small off-by-one error in the co-op level selection menu.

[h1]Vote Optimization[/h1]
Now, when one player has started for vote, let's say for restarting the level, the other people may also just tap 'R' and the vote will succeed.

Essentially, if you call for a vote that is already in progress, that vote will automatically count as passed.

[h1]Bug Fix[/h1]
I also fixed a small, off-by-one error in the co-op level selection menu where the level progress text would not show up, it now does as expected.

[h1][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/913600/events/2744275827766911805]Massive Play-Together Event[/url][/h1]
In order to help promote Galactic Lander and it's co-op mode, I will be hosting an [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/913600/events/2744275827766911805]event at the 11th of November, 7:30 PM[/url] where all of us who enjoy playing Galactic Lander will get a chance to discuss the game and complete levels together.

I have also prepared a new voice-channel in the Galactic Lander community chat for us to use during the event.

Finally, if enough people show up to the event, it will be broadcasted live on Galactic Lander's store page.

Don't delay, tell your friends and lets all have fun during this upcoming event!


Thanks for reading, and have fun!
 - ZeroByter.

notes.title: Bugs Hotfix And Nearing Galactic Missions
notes.notes:
Hi!

Today's update fixed two bugs, both involving co-op gameplay.

[h1]Missiles Synchronzation[/h1]
When I first started working on co-op for Galactic Lander, I made sure every action in the game was synchronized between clients, missiles also worked back then.

Apparently, something I changed since then has broken missiles again, and I have now fixed the issue.

[h1]Landing Pad Capturing Progress[/h1]
While playing the game, a friend of mine and I discovered that in no-gravity co-op mode, it's impossible to complete a level since you have to stick your ship upside onto the landing pad, but this for some reason did not work in co-op.

In co-op, every player ship except your own gets it's physics disabled, and therefore also it's collisions are disabled (how can you touch something without physics?), and so the landing pad wasn't registering the contact between it and the other player's ship.

I fixed this by correctly synchronizing when each landing pad started or stopped getting captured.

[h1]Galactic Missions[/h1]
The first galactic mission, although still a surprise secret, will start in the next few upcoming weeks! Follow us on [url=https://www.instagram.com/zerobyter_games/]Instagram[/url] to see when we will post a teaser of the galactic mission!


Thanks for reading, and as always, have fun!

notes.title: New Update And Official Instagram
notes.notes:
Hello all!

[h1]Brand-New Instagram![/h1]
We have created our very own [url=https://www.instagram.com/zerobyter_games/]Instagram![/url] On it, we will occasionally post sneak-peaks and teasers regarding Galactic Lander and Space Fighters!

Follow our Instagram and be in the know about future teasers!

[h1]New Update[/h1]
This update improved some small, already-existing features and fixed a bug where the lobby browser would unnecessarily refresh every two seconds.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33541654/0ad236cf3fc68ae9ab1ae8170fc5bb5d5f7fbef2.png[/img]

In addition, I have added a small and obscure button on the main menu in order to refresh the UI in case something unexpected goes wrong.

Finally, the update further makes preparations for future 'Galactic Missions' to be able to take place. I anticipate Galactic Missions to be fully integrated in the game within the next 1-2 days. (although the first Galactic Mission won't begin until a few more weeks, stay tuned for news about that!)

[h1]First Gameplay Video![/h1]
One of my biggest wish or 'landmark' in my Steam-indie-game-developing adventure is for my game to be reviewed and to be able to hear feedback from the community.

Yesterday, that wish was granted when [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/32116970-Press-Start-To-Begin-Curator/]Press Start To Begin[/url] published a full 10-minute gameplay video of Galactic Lander! I was very excited and happy to see my very own game getting recognition on a platform such as YouTube.


That is all for today's announcement! Don't forget to follow Galactic Lander on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/913600/Galactic_Lander/]Steam[/url] to be in the know about future awesome announcements!

notes.title: Patch Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

After a few days of hard work since the last patch update, I have patched some more relatively minor bugs and fixes. Although most of the work I do on Galactic Lander at this time goes towards preparing for the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/913600/announcements/detail/1681423596654783250]galactic missions[/url] coming soon.

[h1]On Another Note...[/h1]
Almost every day I check up on Galactic Lander. I visit the Steam workshop, check the forum discussions for any new threads, and I even check the store page to see if any new user reviews were written for Galactic Lander.

I especially love to read the user-reviews because it allows me to listen to the community in one of the best ways possible. It makes me happy to see positive reviews, obviously because it shows me people enjoy my game; and I look forward to reading negative reviews so that I could see where I could improve.

notes.title: Minor Update And Galactic Missions
notes.notes:
Hello!

[h1]The Update[/h1]
I have just released a relatively small update for Galactic Lander. This update adds detail to the engine sprite when it is broken (because I forget to add it before) and other minor fixes/changes.

[h1]Game Events[/h1]
I'm a fan of CS:GO's occasional 'operations'. Once in a while Valve would release an 'operation' for CS:GO which players can purchase a 'pass' for and take part in. Completing the operation will grant you a 'coin' to show off in-game.

In an effort to add something similar to Galactic Lander, I am in the midst of adding in to the game support for various future 'galactic situations'. These 'galactic missions' will be free for all immediately as they begin. Completing a mission will grant the player an exclusive ship skin they could either play with in singleplayer, or show off in co-op mode.

[h1]Bugs And General Game Feedback[/h1]
I would like remind to you, the players, if you encounter bugs in-game, or simply have suggestions for the game, I highly recommend you to make your voice heard either on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/913600/discussions/1/]Steam forums[/url] or on the [url=https://galacticlander.zerobyter.net/feedback]official game website[/url].

I really love to hear feedback from the community, and I do act upon suggestions & bug reports as players submit them.


That is all for today's announcement, thanks for reading, and have fun!

notes.title: Game Release!
notes.notes:
Hey!

I am happy to announce Galactic Lander is finally released to the Steam platform!

I am looking forward to hearing precious feedback from the community, playing with players in co-op mode, and playing your awesome workshop levels!

Have a good game, and have fun!

notes.title: Update, Bug Fixes, And One Day Until Release!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Over the past few days I have been consistently patching Galactic Lander and fine-tuning it for release day, tomorrow.

[h1]Level Editor and Workshop Publishing[/h1]
I have made some adjustments to the in-game level editor, such as updating old text prompts, and fixing bugs.

I have also fixed a bug where if a user is uploading a level but needs to agree to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/workshoplegalagreement]Steam's workshop terms of agreement[/url] first, the file would upload anyways as a blank item.

[h1]Preparing For Release Day And Beyond[/h1]

Most of the patches and fixes I have been able to provide have been in thanks to feedback and review from the community. This feedback from the 'closed-beta stage' players has proven tremendously useful and of course, even after release day, I urge all players who find faults with the game, or simply have suggestions, to report them either on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/913600/discussions/1/]Steam forums[/url] or on the [url=https://galacticlander.zerobyter.net/feedback]official Galactic Lander website[/url].

I am very excited for Galactic Lander's nearing release. Ever since day one of me working on this game, the one thing I was and still am most excited for will be being able to browse the Steam workshop and to admire all the wonderful levels players created together with our game.

notes.title: Achievements And Nearing Release
notes.notes:
Hi! I'll get right to the progress update.

[h1]Game achievements[/h1]
19 awesome achievements have been added for the game. Although if you are reading this announcement before the game is released you won't be able to see them but trust me, they are fun.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33541654/4149e792418d8f77a96dff07d52f2277e5ebef31.png[/img]

[h1]Finishing touches[/h1]
My pre-release schedule for Galactic Lander is as follows:
[b]Next two-three days[/b] will be me wraping up small the small/quick things that are left to be done from the [url=https://trello.com/b/pm3OYtL1/galactic-lander]Galactic Lander Trello[/url]

[b]One day[/b] testing (especially co-op) features to make sure everything is in squeaky clean order.

[b]Rest of the time until release[/b] polishing up the final details and adding in the rest of the missing game levels.


And that's it really! There really is not much left to do. I'll keep you all posted with more progress as it comes up!

Also, remember to keep an ear out for the date of the closed-beta giveaway! Wouldn't want to miss it!

notes.title: Updated Release Date And More Progress
notes.notes:
Hello!

I wanted to give you all a little 'progress-report' on the game's development.

First of all, I am very pleased to announce I have moved forward the release date from the 18th of October to the 4th of October simply because development is going very well and soon I will run out of tasks on [url=https://trello.com/b/pm3OYtL1/galactic-lander]Galactic Lander's Trello[/url] to work on.

[h1]Closed-Beta Giveaway[/h1]
In my opinion, a game's release is not complete without a closed-beta giveaway. Therefore, in the upcoming days or weeks, I will announce the official date for said giveaway. I recommend following Galactic Lander and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/zerobyter]myself[/url] to be notified of when the giveaway will begin.

Since Galactic Lander is really more fun with a friend in co-op mode, I recommend getting your friends to join the giveaway too, once it begins, so that you will be able to enjoy the game together!

That is all for now! Thanks for reading, and game on!
